title: 采样反向提示词（独立字段）

standard.summary: 预览与质量评估采样使用的独立 negative prompt 字段；为空时回落到 negative_prompts。UI 上填 negative_prompts 会被自动映射到本键。
standard.effect: 预览组（preview_groups）未单独指定 negative 时、质量评估采样、验证套件采样都读取本值作为反向提示词。
standard.whenToUse: 想让预览/评估的 negative 与训练常用 UI 字段解耦、或以 TOML 直连后端配置时。
standard.avoidWhen: 已通过 negative_prompts 填写时无需重复（别名映射只在本键为空时生效，两处都填以本键为准）。

standard_en.summary: The separate negative prompt field used by preview and quality-evaluation sampling; when empty it falls back to negative_prompts. Filling in negative_prompts in the UI maps to this key automatically.
standard_en.effect: This value is read as the negative prompt when a preview group (preview_groups) does not name its own negative, and by quality-evaluation sampling and validation-suite sampling.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want the preview/evaluation negative decoupled from the UI field you normally use, or when you configure the backend directly through TOML.
standard_en.avoidWhen: No need to repeat it once negative_prompts is filled in (the alias mapping only applies while this key is empty, and if both are filled this key wins).

advanced.principle: 后端把预览 negative 收敛为单一权威字段：所有采样消费方（预览 pipeline、质量评估、验证套件）统一读 sample_negative，UI 层的 negative_prompts 仅是别名入口，避免多处 negative 定义不一致。
advanced.intervention: config_adapter_training_shared.py 与 field_alias_map.py：negative_prompts → sample_negative（仅在目标键缺失时映射）；消费方：trainer_config_preview_target_mixin.py（预览组回落）、trainer_quality_runtime.py、quality_evaluation_sampling.py、validation_suite.py。
advanced.expectedImpact: 预览与评估图的 negative 行为一致、可追溯。
advanced.tradeoffs: 无训练影响；只作用于采样类输出。

advanced_en.principle: The backend consolidates the preview negative into a single authoritative field: all sampling consumers (preview pipeline, quality evaluation, validation suite) read sample_negative uniformly, and the UI layer's negative_prompts is only an alias entry, avoiding inconsistent negative definitions in multiple places.
advanced_en.intervention: config_adapter_training_shared.py and field_alias_map.py: negative_prompts → sample_negative (mapped only when the target key is missing); consumers: trainer_config_preview_target_mixin.py (preview group fallback), trainer_quality_runtime.py, quality_evaluation_sampling.py, validation_suite.py.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Preview and evaluation images behave identically for the negative and stay traceable.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: No training impact; only affects sampling-type outputs.
